input.quote: 2.1 The Company shall provide all Content to HDI to be included in the Site no later than ten (10) days from the date this Agreement has been executed by both Parties.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property ownership provision. We supply all Content and license our "Deerskin" Marks to HDI (p0038-p0039), and HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and collects customer/order data (p0005, p0010), yet nothing states who owns the Site, the deliverables, the Content or the customer and order data. Confidentiality (Section 8) protects our Content and user information from disclosure but does not establish ownership or grant us any rights in the developed Site; Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control. There is no assignment of our IP or data to HDI and no joint ownership (Section 10.2 disclaims co-ownership of the relationship), so this is not walk-away territory, but the rule expects an ownership clause and none exists. We propose a short Section 5.5 reaching the preferred position: we retain Content, Marks and customer/order data; HDI assigns the Site and other deliverables while keeping its pre-existing platform and tools subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence back to us; no joint ownership.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns and shall retain all right, title and interest in and to (a) the Content, the Marks and all other materials, data and information supplied by or on behalf of the Company, and (b) all customer, user and order data collected through the Site relating to Deerskin Products. HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest in and to the Site (including its design, look and feel and any other deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement), excluding HDI's pre-existing and generally applicable software, tools, platform and know-how, which HDI retains and in respect of which HDI grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such HDI materials solely to the extent embedded in or necessary to use the Site and such deliverables for the Company's business. Nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns any of the Company's intellectual property or data to HDI, and no joint or co-ownership of any intellectual property is created.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on ownership even though we pay for the Site through Net Sales and supply all Content, Marks and customer data, so we have added a short ownership section: we retain our Content, Marks and customer/order data, HDI assigns the Site and other deliverables to us while keeping its pre-existing platform and tools, and we take a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any HDI materials embedded in the deliverables. If HDI prefers to retain ownership of its generic tools and know-how, we can work from that licence-back approach as our fallback, but we cannot leave ownership of our data and deliverables unaddressed.
proposal.summary: Insert new Section 5.5 (Ownership): Company retains Content, Marks and customer/order data; HDI assigns Site/deliverables with licence-back of its pre-existing platform; no assignment of Company IP and no joint ownership.
